controlProtocol.method: Offline exhaustive finite-grid search of a causal feedback rule; no claim of global continuous optimum or MPC
controlProtocol.design_score: Equal-scenario mean energy ratio: candidate terminal energy plus positive excess terminal battery heat versus baseline divided by COP (ambient >=25C only), plus absolute terminal cabin difference correction divided by min(COP,heater efficiency), then divided by baseline energy
controlProtocol.constraints_note: Comfort, safety, dwell, compressor budget, regen settings and preconditioning are declared engineering assumptions, not organizer-provided certified ratings.
controlProtocol.information_note: Controller uses current simulated/sensed state, current ambient and planned remaining trip time; no future speed. Terminal return assumes a known planned arrival time.
controlProtocol.thermal_accounting_note: Terminal heat correction is an idealized accounting diagnostic, not an actual continuation simulation or proof of long-run saving. Report raw energy and corrected energy, temperatures and comfort deviation together.

controlLimitations: Simulation-only control evidence. Calibrated OCV transfer, Cr, initial temperatures and unmeasured thermal dynamics remain uncertain.
Cabin starts preconditioned24C, initialSOC94%; excludes energy before trip and differs from Q1 reference initialSOC80%.
Known planned trip end is required for terminal cabin return; no future speed supplied.
Thermal correction uses an idealized COP accounting estimate; it does not replace long-duration cyclic or recovery validation.
Temperature sensor bias may violate tight terminal equality even when safety and comfort hold; report failures rather than silently relaxing the constraint.
